desc: 成排主图开场，防滑不鼓包痛点加绒面微距与空参数规格的衣柜收纳套图
name: 天鹅绒防滑不鼓包衣架款

shots.intent: 用成排数量感在搜索列表里一眼抢到点击，同时暗示整组收纳的划算感
一秒给出三条核心利益的结构位，图标与标签全部留空待填
用同机位双栏把衣物滑落与肩部鼓包的日常烦恼放大，把主体放到解决侧
用微距把绒面摩擦质感与吊带卡槽的真实做工摊开，替卖点做证据
把主体放进真实衣柜，让买家照着自己的挂杆想象整理后的样子
用顶视造型图把收纳后的秩序感与款式氛围立住，承接情绪价值
用尺寸引线与放大镜框的结构位消解大小疑虑，数值全部留空待填
用两组束带分组让买家自己挑组合，纸带印刷位全部留白
顶视清单式网格收口整组，把主体压在最大位并留一条空白横幅做转化位

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, pale greige panels #F2EFEA and #E7E4E0 for info and scene screens, one cool near-white #F7F8F9 for spec screens
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in slate #2C3A47 with one amber #E8701A accent, flat, no fills, no 3d
style.lightingSystem: neutral broad front-left key with soft fill, high-key even on packshots, soft daylight in scenes, gentle contact shadows only, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent tidy wardrobe-organisation visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, pale greige panels #F2EFEA and #E7E4E0, deep slate text #2C3A47 and one warm amber accent #E8701A; neutral studio lighting with a broad front-left key, soft fill and gentle contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif; thin single-weight line icon style; clean high-end homeware product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable dead-on front product elevation and consistent scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no rendered words or numbers inside the frame.
noDrift: no rendered words, numbers or units inside the frame
style.presentationRules: stable dead-on front elevation for the single unit, consistent scale across the set, units always grounded by a contact shadow, never clipped
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless studio board and pale closet interior surfaces, matte rail and shelf edges, no gloss tabletops
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, in-image copy fully stripped, only blank label bars and empty leader-line slots remain
